title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 25 — Explanation Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: You rent an apartment and have been unable to pay your rent on time for the past two months. This happened because your employer experienced a payroll system failure that delayed salary payments to all staff. The issue has since been fully resolved and all outstanding salary has been paid.
questions.prompt:
You rent an apartment and have been unable to pay your rent on time for the past two months. This happened because your employer experienced a payroll system failure that delayed salary payments to all staff. The issue has since been fully resolved and all outstanding salary has been paid.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• apologise for the late rental payments and acknowledge the inconvenience caused
• explain clearly what caused the delay and why it was entirely beyond your personal control
• confirm exactly when the full outstanding amount will be transferred and how you will ensure payments remain on time in the future

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: In many countries, housing costs have risen considerably faster than average wages over the past two decades. What factors have contributed to this problem and what measures could governments take to make housing more affordable for ordinary people?
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
